name: scan
eval: import('/src/game/obstacles.js').then(O=>{const out=[];for(let x=-110;x<=110;x+=4)for(let z=-140;z<=110;z+=4){let ok=true;for(let a=-7;a<=7&&ok;a+=1.5)for(let b=-7;b<=9&&ok;b+=1.5){if(O.blockedByBuilding(x+a,z+b)||O.platformTop(x+a,z+b)!=null)ok=false;}if(ok)out.push(x+','+z);}return out.length+' :: '+out.filter(p=>{const[x,z]=p.split(',').map(Number);return Math.hypot(x,z)<120}).join(' ')})
